Description:
Re-reads the manifest.
This method can be used to prepare for updates of the Key-Value Storages and File Storages of
Persistency after a new manifest was installed by UCM while the Adaptive Application that uses
Persistency is running. Storages are only updated after closing them, either when they are
opened again or by an explicit call to UpdatePersistency.
